decisions.reason: The request for Google indexing counts and indexing-tool usage does not change the required backlink count or dofollow/nofollow proportions.
The source requests backlink-indexing information, not a change to the separate on-page SEO completion report.
Backlink indexing status and tool usage do not alter the selected campaign keywords, keyword count, or mapped page.
The indexing inquiry does not modify blog quantity, delivery timing, publication conditions, or publication obligations.
The source concerns indexing of backlinks and has no entailed effect on missing or optimized image ALT attributes.
The backlink-indexing report request does not change the required webpage content replacement or revision target.
Although both Requirements involve reporting, this is a distinct backlink-indexing inquiry and does not change the Friday weekly work-summary schedule or coverage.
The requested backlink indexing count does not affect the number or relevance of images required in blog articles.
The source refers to indexing off-page backlinks, not the destinations, applicability, or publication timing of internal blog links.
